WITH lines AS (
  SELECT f.*, p.sku, p.subcategory AS sub_asof, cp.subcategory AS sub_current, p.category
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
  WHERE s.store_id = 108 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-07-31'
    AND (cp.subcategory = 'Interior Paint' OR p.subcategory = 'Interior Paint')
)
SELECT 'rows' k, CAST(count(*) AS VARCHAR) v FROM lines
UNION ALL SELECT 'distinct sales_line_id', CAST(count(distinct sales_line_id) AS VARCHAR) FROM lines
UNION ALL SELECT 'distinct receipt+line', CAST(count(distinct (receipt_id, line_no)) AS VARCHAR) FROM lines
UNION ALL SELECT 'sub differs', CAST(count(*) AS VARCHAR) FROM lines WHERE sub_asof <> sub_current
UNION ALL SELECT 'min/max date', CAST(min(sale_date) AS VARCHAR)||' '||CAST(max(sale_date) AS VARCHAR) FROM lines
UNION ALL SELECT 'category ' || category, CAST(count(*) AS VARCHAR) FROM lines GROUP BY category
UNION ALL SELECT 'P3 dates', CAST(period_start_date AS VARCHAR)||' '||CAST(period_end_date AS VARCHAR)||' loaded='||CAST(fully_loaded AS VARCHAR) FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period=3
UNION ALL SELECT 'channel '||coalesce(channel_code,'null'), CAST(count(*) AS VARCHAR) FROM lines GROUP BY channel_code
UNION ALL SELECT 'neg/zero qty', CAST(count(*) AS VARCHAR) FROM lines WHERE quantity<=0

WITH lines AS (
  SELECT f.*, p.sku, p.product_name, p.category, cp.subcategory AS sub_current
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  WHERE s.store_id = 108 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=3
    AND cp.subcategory = 'Interior Paint'
)
SELECT 'units' k, CAST(sum(quantity) AS VARCHAR) v FROM lines
UNION ALL SELECT 'units excl staff', CAST(sum(quantity) FILTER (WHERE NOT staff_purchase_flag) AS VARCHAR) FROM lines
UNION ALL SELECT 'lines', CAST(count(*) AS VARCHAR) FROM lines
UNION ALL SELECT 'max qty', CAST(max(quantity) AS VARCHAR) FROM lines
UNION ALL SELECT 'net', CAST(sum(net_amount) AS VARCHAR) FROM lines
UNION ALL SELECT 'distinct etl_loaded_at', CAST(count(distinct etl_loaded_at) AS VARCHAR) FROM lines
UNION ALL SELECT 'ZZ test lines', CAST(count(*) AS VARCHAR) FROM lines WHERE category='ZZ Test'
UNION ALL SELECT 'min/max sale_date', CAST(min(sale_date) AS VARCHAR)||' '||CAST(max(sale_date) AS VARCHAR) FROM lines
UNION ALL SELECT 'returned units (any date)', CAST(coalesce(sum(r.quantity_returned),0) AS VARCHAR) FROM fact_return_line r WHERE r.sales_line_id IN (SELECT sales_line_id FROM lines)
UNION ALL SELECT 'units by week '||CAST(d.fiscal_week AS VARCHAR), CAST(sum(l.quantity) AS VARCHAR) FROM lines l JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=l.sale_date GROUP BY d.fiscal_week

WITH a AS (
  SELECT sum(f.net_amount) AS net_before, count(distinct f.receipt_id) AS receipts, sum(f.quantity) AS units
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id=108 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
), b AS (
  SELECT sum(net_sales_before_returns) AS net_before, sum(receipts) AS receipts, sum(units_sold) AS units, count(*) AS days
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=108 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
)
SELECT a.net_before, b.net_before, a.receipts, b.receipts, a.units, b.units, b.days FROM a, b
